## Progress

- Merged [PR #689](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/689): Settings -> Audit log tab (`/settings?tab=audit`). `GET /v1/audit/access-log` and `GET /v1/audit/access-log/patients/{patientId}` need the Audit log capability (practice admin, owner doctor, hospital IT; any other role 403 and an audit.read event with outcome Denied). Filters: staff member, patient (front-desk search reused), action, dates (default last 30 days); newest first with keyset paging. Rows show time, staff, current role, action, patient MRN, purpose and outcome written out (Allowed / Denied / Not found / Rejected); the patient's name appears only on the per-patient route, whose audit.read event carries that patient id. Denied attempts by other roles show with outcome Denied. `POST /v1/audit/access-log/export` returns a CSV watermarked first and last row with exporter and time, MRNs not names, formula cells neutralised, and writes audit.export. New index (TenantId, OccurredAt) on the ledger table. Mutation-checked (capability removed, name gate removed: tests fail). EN/HI/AR, RTL, axe clean
- Left: role as held at event time (the log shows the person's current role), the filters used in the export event, a measured p95 on 30 days of pilot volume (indexed, not load-tested), read-volume alert on unusual patient reads (MDV-P1-018 follow-up), patient filter for hospital IT (the patient search needs Register / book patients), per-facility scoping inside a tenant

## Description

/settings/audit: filter by staff member, patient (search), action, date range; shows time, actor, role, action, patient (name visible to the owner after selecting), purpose and outcome (allowed/denied). Export to CSV (watermarked, audited).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Only practice owners/admins can open the log (403 for others, audited).
- [ ] **AC2.** Filtering by patient lists every read and write of that patient's record by anyone, with timestamps.
- [ ] **AC3.** Denied attempts (e.g. receptionist opening a clinical note) appear with outcome "Denied".
- [ ] **AC4.** Exports are audited and watermarked with exporter and time.
- [ ] **AC5.** Query p95 < 600 ms for a 30-day range in the pilot volume.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
